So,} \Value{t}{M}[s_1] & = \Value{\Atom{f}{t_1, \dots, t_k}}{M}[s_1] \\ & = \Assign{f}{M}(\Value{t_1}{M}[s_1], \dots, \Value{t_k}{M}[s_1]) \\ & = \Assign{f}{M}(\Value{t_1}{M}[s_2], \dots, \Value{t_k}{M}[s_2]) \\ & = \Value{\Atom{f}{t_1, \dots, t_k}}{M}[s_2] = \Value{t}{M}[s_2].
